use_case: Pipeline leak-detection anomaly model: scores 1-minute pressure, flow, temperature, and valve data for 58 mainline segments and alerts controllers to possible leaks or ruptures
vendor_or_model: Leak-detection model vendor (machine learning anomaly detection with mass-balance features), tuned on 24 months of company historian data; runs in the company's OT analytics cloud account (P04)
data_categories: SCADA historian data from the DMZ replica (pressures, flows, temperatures, valve states); no personal information
affects_individuals: No (indirectly: people who live and work along the route)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory only. Alerts appear on a separate screen in the control room; the controller treats each alert as a prompt to check SCADA trends and, if needed, follows the abnormal operating or emergency procedure. The model has no path to SCADA
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 192.615(a)(12) (rupture identification procedures must specify sources of information); 49 CFR 192.631(c), (e)(5), (f), (h) (controller information, workload, change coordination, training); 192.705 and 192.706 remain required; TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G Section VI (amendment for the OT analytics account) and III.B (one-way data path); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor accuracy claims, indirect)
status: In production (advisory) since 2025-08; approved with conditions 2026-09-17

use_case: Compressor predictive maintenance: the OEM's service analyzes unit vibration and performance data and recommends maintenance for the 14 compressor units
vendor_or_model: Compressor OEM remote diagnostics service (vendor-hosted machine learning models)
data_categories: Unit vibration, temperature, and performance data; unit configuration identifiers; no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Compressor Station Supervisors and the OEM field engineer review each recommendation; maintenance follows the O&M manual and OEM procedures. Nothing is written back to unit panels
applicable_laws: TSA SD Pipeline-2021-02G Sections II.A.4, III.B.1.b, III.B.2.a (the data path is an external connection to OT); 49 CFR 192.605 (O&M procedures remain controlling); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims, indirect)
status: Data collection suspended since 2026-08-13 (modem disconnected); resumes only through the DMZ path by 2026-10-31

use_case: Right-of-way imagery change detection: flags new construction, excavation, and encroachment near the pipeline from monthly aerial and satellite imagery
vendor_or_model: Imagery analytics vendor (computer vision change detection), SaaS
data_categories: Aerial and satellite imagery of the right-of-way; GIS centerline (Restricted, shared under contract); images may incidentally show people, vehicles, and private property
affects_individuals: No (indirectly: landowners and excavators near the pipeline)
human_in_the_loop: The GIS team reviews every flag and sends confirmed ones to the Area Manager for a field visit or a damage prevention contact. Patrols under 192.705 continue on their normal schedule
applicable_laws: 49 CFR 192.705 (patrols remain the required method); 192.614 damage prevention program (unchanged); POL-04 (centerline data shared with the vendor under contract); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims, indirect)
status: Pilot since 2026-03 on 3 areas; expansion to all 6 areas after local validation (2027-03-31)

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for drafting, summarizing, and searching business documents
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI assistant (large language model) inside the productivity suite tenant, with no training on company data
data_categories: Business documents and email the user can already access; prohibited: SSI, Restricted OT information, CEII, and employee personal information
human_in_the_loop: Users review all output before use; output may not be the basis of a safety, compliance, or personnel decision without human verification against the source
applicable_laws: POL-04 and POL-05 4.8 (data rules); 49 CFR Part 1520 (SSI may not be disclosed to the tool unless the tool is an approved SSI location); Fla. Stat. 501.171 and other state laws if personal information were exposed; NIST AI 600-1 (Generative AI Profile) used as guidance
status: Pilot with 40 business users since 2026-06; general release after conditions (2026-12-31); public AI tools blocked on company devices at release

use_case: Machine learning malware and behavior detection in the MSSP-operated EDR on business endpoints
vendor_or_model: EDR platform operated by the MSSP
data_categories: Endpoint telemetry; limited user activity data
human_in_the_loop: MSSP analysts review alerts; automatic isolation applies to business endpoints only, never to OT devices
applicable_laws: None AI-specific; covered by the MSSP contract and SOC 2 review (P09 VEN-01)
